conditions.instrument: Zetasizer Pro Blue particle size analyzer (Malvern Instruments, Malvern, UK)

measurements.evidence_quote: The mean ζ-potential was -40.66 ± 1.04 mV, consistent with high colloidal stability and a low tendency to aggregate (Figure 1B). || At 25 °C, the hydrodynamic diameter, polydispersity index (PDI), and zeta potential (ζ-potential) of particles dispersed in distilled water were determined by laser Doppler velocimetry (LDV) using a Zetasizer Pro Blue particle size analyzer (Malvern Instruments, Malvern, UK) after brief ultrasonication.
